column1: # ENCODE files for the multi-cell-type p300 panel, selected 2026-09-18.
# ATAC: paired-ended 100 bp Snyder-lab experiments in every cell type, matching
#   K562 ENCSR868FGK, so run type and read length are constant across the panel.
# EP300: single-ended everywhere but 36-51 bp across three labs. Read length barely
#   affects a 5-prime-end target (the 5-prime position is the alignment start), but
#   antibody and protocol differ by lab and that is a real batch effect.
# BAM choice: unfiltered alignments for ChIP (filtered locally), filtered alignments
#   for ATAC, per reference/DATA_INVENTORY.md. Where a replicate had several BAMs
#   from different reprocessings, the most recent was taken.
